build.buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @paltas2026/shared build && pnpm --filter @paltas2026/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @paltas2026/api build

deploy.startCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @paltas2026/api exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @paltas2026/api start:prod
